title: HigherDose Advertising Claims Referred to Regulators After Noncompliance With NAD Inquiries
summary: The wellness brand declined to participate in two NAD inquiries into performance claims about its Red Light Hat and Red Light Face Mask, prompting a referral to regulatory authorities.

extraction.key_fact: HigherDose가 NAD 조사에 응하지 않아 광고 주장이 규제 당국에 회부됐다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: The wellness brand declined to participate in two NAD inquiries into performance claims about its Red Light Hat and Red Light Face Mask, prompting a referral to regulatory authorities.
